fusions.name: Picked Out
fusions.desc: A sting at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 22 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Marked] for 10 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Scout Darts
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stings in a wide spread, each dealing 3 damage, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Exposed], its resistances stripped, for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Compound Sight
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Ocelli Circlet
fusions.desc: Conjures a circlet: your critical hit chance rises by 6%, your critical hits deal 15% more damage, and each kill returns 3 health. The effect grows 5% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
